# CenterOnDigital

> CenterOnDigital has provided penetration testing, Red Team, ISO 27001 and KVKK consulting since 2020, and builds the SURFACEMON threat intelligence platform.

CenterOnDigital is a cybersecurity company offering penetration testing, consulting, and risk assessments.
We operate from 4 offices in Turkey: İstanbul, Ankara, Düzce and Gebze (Kocaeli).
Our parent company is ATM Isı Transfer A.Ş.
Contact us at info@centerondigital.com or +90 212 924 24 16.
Note that the site is bilingual: Turkish at /, English at /en/.

## Services
- [Penetration Testing](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/testing/#penetration-testing): We test your systems through an attacker's eyes.
- [BDDK Compliant Pentest](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/testing/#bddk-compliant-pentest): Penetration testing and reporting to BDDK regulations.
- [DDoS / DoS Testing](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/testing/#ddos-dos-testing): Resilience testing against denial-of-service attacks.
- [Red Team](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/testing/#red-team): Realistic attack simulation that goes beyond compliance.
- [Social Engineering](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/testing/#social-engineering): Phishing and people-focused attack testing.
- [Information & Communication Security Guide](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/consulting/#big-guide-consulting): Compliance consulting for the Presidential BİG Guide.
- [ISO 27001 Consulting](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/consulting/#iso27001-consulting): ISMS setup and certification support.
- [KVKK Consulting](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/consulting/#kvkk-consulting): Personal data protection (KVKK) compliance consulting.
- [Security Maturity & Cyber Risk Assessment](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/assessment/#security-maturity-assessment): We measure your security maturity and risk.
- [Information Asset Inventory Management](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/assessment/#information-asset-management): Inventory and classification of your information assets.
- [IT Health Check](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/services/assessment/#it-health-check): A thorough health scan of your IT infrastructure.

## Products
- [SURFACEMON](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/surfacemon/): External attack surface management platform.
- [RevBits](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/revbits/): Cyber intelligence and defense products.

- [Toplumun yüzde 65’i olası siber risklere karşı kendini güvende hissetmiyor](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/blog/toplumun-yuzde-65i-siber-riskler/): Sektör temsilcileri bilgilendirme ve eğitimin önemine atıf yaparken, siber güvenlik sigortası ürünlerinin kullanılması ve çeşitlenmesi gerektiğine dik...
- [Uzaktan Çalışma Neden Bizi Siber Saldırılara Karşı Savunmasız Bırakıyor?](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/blog/uzaktan-calisma-siber-saldiri-savunmasiz/): Uzaktan çalışma siber riskleri artırıyor: REvil'in Kaseya saldırısı, evden çalışırken edinilen kötü güvenlik alışkanlıkları ve pandemi temalı phishing artışı.
- [Unprecedented Blackmail Scheme Using Deepfake Technology](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/blog/deepfake-uygulamasiyla-santaj/): A deepfake blackmail case in Turkey: a Samsun school owner was threatened with fake explicit footage for 100,000 euros. Plus how GAN-based deepfakes work.
- [Hackers Can Now Pick Your Physical Door Lock Using Audio](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/blog/hackerlar-kapinizin-kilidini-kirabilecek/): SpiKey acoustic attack: researchers show how a key's clicks in a lock, recorded by a phone microphone, can narrow its bittings to about 5 candidate keys.
- [Irish Healthcare System Hit by Cyberattack: Hospitals Revert to Pen and Paper](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/blog/irlanda-saglik-sistemi-siber-saldiri/): The Irish healthcare system was crippled by a sophisticated cyberattack, prompting an emergency shutdown of all IT systems as a precautionary measure.
- [Cyberattacks Targeting Schools Surge Threefold](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/blog/okullara-yonelik-siber-saldirilar/): Cyberattacks on schools have tripled as student data becomes a prime target. Only about 20% of US schools have security teams, and .edu phishing is a risk.
- [The Aftermath of a Cyberattack: Inside Scripps Health Hospital in San Diego](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/blog/san-diego-scripps-hospital-siber-attack/): Ransomware at Scripps Health, San Diego: our Chairman's firsthand account of systems still down after 17 days, paper charts, lost X-rays and halted billing.
- [Types of Penetration Testing](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/blog/sizma-testi-turleri/): Penetration testing types: external and internal network tests, web application pentests, automated vulnerability scanning, social engineering and red teaming.
- [65% of the Population Feels Insecure Against Emerging Cyber Risks](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/blog/toplumun-yuzde-65i-siber-riskler/): Industry leaders highlight the imperative for cybersecurity awareness, education, and the widespread adoption of specialized cyber insurance policies.
- [Why Remote Work Leaves Us Vulnerable to Cyberattacks](https://www.centerondigital.com/centerondigital-t/en/blog/uzaktan-calisma-siber-saldiri-savunmasiz/): The ransomware syndicate REvil deliberately timed its widespread attack over the July 4th weekend, exploiting reduced staffing in enterprise IT departments.
